subject: Billing transition: move renewal to AWS Marketplace (pilot)
messages:
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
To: Elena Park <elena.park@blueharborhealth.com>, Marco Diaz <marco.diaz@blueharborhealth.com>
Cc: jonas.weber@redwood.ai
Date: Fri, 18 Jun 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Billing transition: move renewal to AWS Marketplace (pilot)

Hi Elena / Marco,

Quick note ahead of BlueHarbor's July 15 renewal: we'd like to propose moving the upcoming renewal onto the AWS Marketplace as a pilot. The goal is to simplify procurement for BlueHarbor (single invoice via AWS), enable co-sell incentives we can leverage with your cloud team, and shorten payment cycles on your side.

Why we recommend this now:
- Reduces the need for separate POs each renewal period; BlueHarbor can apply a single Marketplace subscription SKU.
- Gives you consolidated billing and a familiar procurement flow.
- Opens up co-sell GTM incentives for a joint push with AWS (we can introduce the AWS account team).

What we'd need from you to scope next steps:
1) Any procurement constraints (PO-only, tax/legal approval windows, vendor-master setup lead time).
2) Whether you need a marketplace SKU + unit pricing visible to your finance team, or if a purchase-order pathway is required.
3) Who on your side should receive a DocuSign amendment for signature (name + email).

I've attached a draft Marketplace amendment and a pricing workbook so your procurement and finance teams can review. If this looks acceptable, we can produce a DocuSign powerform for e-signature and loop in our marketplace specialist to handle the technical entitlements.

Attachments: BH_Marketplace_Amendment_draft_20270618.pdf (PDF), pricing_workbook_bh_20270618.xlsx (XLSX)

Proposed next steps (if you want to move forward):
- You confirm procurement constraints this week
- We produce a marketplace SKU amendment and a DocuSign link by Monday
- Procurement signs; we complete entitlement mapping and co-sell intro within 7 business days

Happy to hop on a 20-min call if you prefer to run through procurement hurdles.

Thanks,
Ben
Ben Carter
Enterprise Account Executive | Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwood.ai | +1 415-555-0124

Ben —

Thanks for the heads up. Procurement looped me in and asked for a couple quick clarifications before they can commit to a marketplace flow:

- BlueHarbor requires a PO on file for all vendor payments. Can your marketplace conversion support a PO-to-invoice mapping (we need the PO # to be visible on invoices)?
- We need a vendor setup form completed (I've attached our standard vendor questionnaire).
- Will pricing be identical on Marketplace? Procurement wants to confirm there is no price increase when moving billing methods.
- Timeline: we need to ensure there's no gap in coverage; the renewal date is 2027-07-15.

If you can confirm the PO requirement and send back the vendor form filled, we can escalate internally and aim to have sign-off before the end of next week.

Cc'ing procurement.

Best,
Elena
Elena Park
Head of Vendor Management | BlueHarbor Health
elena.park@blueharborhealth.com

Thanks for the quick reply. Attached is a draft amendment (BH_Marketplace_Amendment_draft_20270618.pdf) with the following points called out so procurement can review quickly:

- PO mapping: invoices issued via AWS Marketplace will include a Marketplace invoice ID and support a referenced PO field.
